preservation_rule: The original acceptance artifact is retained unchanged as historical provenance.
finding: The live Hunter database contained zero follow-up rows. The original pass relied on test-only qualifying registration and therefore did not demonstrate real follow-up creation and recommendation under the PROD definition.
production_impact: EXO-Hunter must not be called PROD until a real reviewed result is durably registered, displayed with its recommendation and provenance, and safely excluded from execution when its revisit policy is not satisfied.
corrective_plan: Import checksum-verified reviewed prior-search evidence into all durable Hunter entities.
Store explicit search eligibility and revisit rationale on follow-up rows.
Show deferred recommendations while excluding them from Create-New-Search --mode follow-up.
Execute the import and acceptance checks from merged main before issuing a new PROD artifact.
